# Proposal Spots

> A curated directory of the world's most romantic proposal locations, with destination guides, planning articles, budget breakdowns, and a step-by-step checklist.

Proposal Spots helps couples plan memorable marriage proposals. Browse hundreds of hand-picked outdoor spots, restaurant tables, and private settings across popular destinations — each with photos and context. Alongside the directory, the site publishes practical planning guides covering budget, timing, photographer hiring, and proposal formats.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://www.proposalspots.com/): Full directory of proposal spots, filterable by destination, setting, and budget
- [Destinations](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations): Overview of all destination guides
- [Proposal Checklist](https://www.proposalspots.com/checklist): Step-by-step proposal planning checklist
- [Budget Guide](https://www.proposalspots.com/budget-guide): How much a proposal costs and where to spend wisely
- [How It Works](https://www.proposalspots.com/how-it-works): How the directory and planning tools work
- [Inspiration](https://www.proposalspots.com/inspiration): Planning articles and real proposal stories

## Destination Guides

- [Greece](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/greece): Best proposal spots in Greece and Santorini. Top Santorini proposal spots include private caldera-edge terraces in Imerovigli, clifftop restaurant terraces above Fira, the Santo Wines terrace at Pyrgos, and private catamaran charters on the caldera. For a Greece proposal outside Santorini, Nafplio's Venetian harbour (Peloponnese), Mykonos Little Venice waterfront, and the Meteora rock-pillar viewpoints are strong alternatives. Covers Santorini proposal packages ($530 to $1,550 for the moment; $1,400 to $4,300 with cave suite and private dining), proposal photographer booking tips (3 to 6 months ahead for peak season), best times (May, June, September ideal; October underrated), golden-hour windows (7 to 8pm June/July, 6 to 7pm September/October), Oia versus Imerovigli comparison, private catamaran vs group cruise guidance, and a five-setting comparison table. Includes a twelve-question FAQ covering where to propose in Santorini, Greece outside Santorini, package costs, photographer hiring, catamaran proposals, and private terrace vs restaurant differences.
- [Italy](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/italy): Best proposal spots in Italy
- [Amalfi Coast](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/amalfi-coast): Best proposal spots on the Amalfi Coast
- [South of France](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/south-of-france): Best proposal spots in the South of France
- [Portugal](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/portugal): Best proposal spots in Portugal
- [Spain](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/spain): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Spain, including the Carrara marble rotunda at Son Marroig on the Deià sea cliffs in Mallorca (private estate buyout), the private carmen terraces facing the Alhambra in Granada, the Mudéjar courtyards and Jardín de la Danza of the Real Alcázar in Seville, the Neoclassical Temple of Linné rotunda over the sea at the Marimurtra Botanical Garden on the Costa Brava (hourly private buyout), the cliff-edge Jardines de Cuenca above Ronda's El Tajo gorge, the Torre des Savinar overlook facing Es Vedrà in Ibiza, the Monte Igueldo belvedere above the bay of La Concha in San Sebastián, and the vineyard overlook at Santiago Calatrava's Bodegas Ysios in Rioja Alavesa. Leads with Spain's sharp regional climate split (inland Andalusia and central Spain scorching in July and August and best in spring and autumn; the Mediterranean coast and Balearic Islands warmest June to September; the green north and Basque Country milder and wetter, best June to September; the Canary Islands spring-like November to April) and the very late Spanish summer daylight, with sunset near 21:30 and twilight past 22:15 in June and July because Spain runs on Central European Time. Covers proposal photographer costs ($450 to $1,000 for a 60 to 100 minute session, $1,000 to $2,200 for editorial and destination specialists), staged moment totals ($1,600 to $4,700) and full three-night five-star stays ($7,100 to $21,000+), municipal photography permits for heritage sites such as Seville's Real Alcázar (~$216), high-speed rail (Madrid to Barcelona in about 2h30, Madrid to Seville in about 2h39), the late Spanish dining schedule, euro currency, and 90-day Schengen visa-free entry for US citizens with ETIAS rescheduled to late 2026 or 2027. Includes a five-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Switzerland](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/switzerland): Best proposal spots in Switzerland, including the Matterhorn Glacier Paradise above Zermatt (3,883m), Grindelwald First ridge in the Bernese Oberland, Lake Lucerne at Brunnen, the Lavaux wine terraces above Lake Geneva, and Lauterbrunnen valley. Covers Switzerland proposal packages, photographer tips, best times (September ideal), and costs from $800.
- [Austria](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/austria): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Austria, including the lakeside promenade of Hallstatt and a private wooden Plätte boat charter on the lake in the Salzkammergut, the elevated Gloriette colonnade above the gardens of Schönbrunn Palace and the reflection basin at the Upper Belvedere in Vienna, the Hafelekar summit cross on the Nordkette above Innsbruck in Tyrol, the suspended 5 Fingers viewing platform on the Dachstein Krippenstein at Obertraun, the "Dinner for 2 im See" floating raft on the Millstätter See in Carinthia, the Pegasus balustrade of the Mirabell Palace gardens in Salzburg, the Kriegerhorn powder ridge above Lech-Zürs in the Vorarlberg Arlberg, and the Edelweissspitze on the summer-only Grossglockner High Alpine Road. Leads with Austria's defining split of two distinct romance seasons that never overlap: green Alpine lakes, open mountain passes and palace gardens in summer (June to September, daylight past 8:30pm) versus snow, ski villages, sleigh rides and Christmas markets in winter (December to March, golden hour around 3:30 to 4:30pm), with Vienna and Salzburg working year-round and glowing with Christkindlmärkte from mid-November. Covers proposal photographer costs ($345 to $575 for a one-hour city session, $575 to $980 for a 2 to 3 hour multi-location shoot, $850 to $1,725 for high-altitude Alpine shoots), staged moment totals ($1,375 to $3,350) and full three-night stays ($2,700 to $12,900+), euro currency at roughly €1 to $1.15, fast ÖBB Railjet rail between Vienna, Salzburg and Innsbruck, 90-day Schengen visa-free entry for US citizens with ETIAS postponed to 2027, and luxury stays including Hotel Sacher, Rosewood Schloss Fuschl, Park Hyatt Vienna, Almhof Schneider and Aurelio Lech. Includes a five-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Iceland](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/iceland): Best proposal spots in Iceland, including a privately chartered Sapphire Blue Ice Cave beneath the Vatnajökull glacier (open November to March), the hidden cavern behind Kvernufoss on the South Coast, Diamond Beach where glacier ice washes onto black sand near Jökulsárlón, the black timber Búðakirkja church on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, and the remote Brennisteinsalda rhyolite crest above Landmannalaugar in the Central Highlands (super-jeep or helicopter access). Leads with Iceland's defining seasonal split, the Northern Lights season (September to mid-April) versus the midnight sun (late May to July), and the huge daylight swing from about 21 hours at the summer solstice to roughly 4 hours at the winter solstice. Covers Iceland proposal packages ($3,850 to $8,400 for the moment; $9,800 to $26,800+ with a three-night five-star stay), proposal photographer costs ($1,500 to $3,500 for a 2 to 3 hour session, $4,000 to $6,500 all-day), best times (September top shoulder month, late February to March top winter window, late June to early July for the midnight sun), natural blue ice caves open November to March, Highland F-roads open in summer only, US-citizen 90-day Schengen visa-free entry with ETIAS pending, cashless krona payments, weather volatility, and luxury stays including The Retreat at Blue Lagoon, Eleven Deplar Farm and Torfhús Retreat. Includes a five-setting comparison table and a nine-question FAQ.
- [Maldives](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/maldives): Best proposal spots in the Maldives
- [Bali](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/bali): Best proposal spots in Bali, including Uluwatu clifftops, Tegallalang rice terraces, Kelingking Beach on Nusa Penida, and private villa infinity pools in Ubud. Covers proposal packages, photographer tips, best times, and costs from $290.
- [Tulum](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/tulum): Best proposal spots in Tulum, Mexico
- [Costa Rica](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/costa-rica): Best proposal spots in Costa Rica, including the Monteverde cloud forest hanging bridges at dawn (6am private access via Selvatura Park), the cliff overlook above Playa Biesanz in Manuel Antonio, Arenal volcano-view platforms near La Fortuna, Playa Santa Teresa on the Nicoya Peninsula, and Nosara's Playa Pelada. Covers Costa Rica proposal packages ($200 to $600 for eco-lodge setup, $800 to $2,500 full-service), proposal photographer costs ($150 to $400), best times (January to March ideal, green season underrated for privacy), and total costs from $320. Includes a comparison table of five settings and a seven-question FAQ.
- [Ecuador](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/ecuador): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Ecuador and the Galapagos Islands, including the Pinnacle Rock summit overlook on Bartolome Island and Tortuga Bay's mangrove-sheltered Playa Mansa cove in the Galapagos, the rooftop VIP terrace at Casa Gangotena above Plaza San Francisco in Quito's colonial Old Town, the Cruz Loma crest reached by the TelefériQo cable car on Pichincha volcano, the Limpiopungo lagoon jetty framing Cotopaxi volcano, the cantilevered Mirador Shalala glass platform over Quilotoa crater lake, the Dragonfly canopy gondola at Mashpi Lodge in the Choco cloud forest, and the motorless canoe platform on Añangu Lake in Yasuni National Park in the Amazon. Leads with Ecuador's two defining traits: it runs on the US dollar so there is no currency math, and its climate is set by altitude and region rather than season (temperate Andean highlands year-round, warm Pacific coast, humid Amazon, misty cloud forest), while the Galapagos keeps its own oceanic rhythm of a warm wetter season December to May and a cool dry garua season June to November. Covers proposal photographer costs ($350 to $750 on the mainland, $800 to $1,500+ in the Galapagos where photographers fly in and pay park fees), staged moment totals ($900 to $2,300 on the mainland, $3,390 to $7,040 in the Galapagos), full three-night stays ($1,650 to $8,320 mainland, $5,890 to $26,140+ Galapagos), the $200 cash Galapagos National Park entry fee plus $20 Transit Control Card (raised August 2024), Galapagos biosecurity rules that bar mainland flowers, high-altitude acclimatization in Quito (2,850m), no-visa 90-day entry for US citizens with a six-month passport rule, and luxury stays including Celebrity Flora, Aqua Mare, the Ecoventura fleet, Pikaia Lodge, Casa Gangotena, Hacienda Zuleta, Mashpi Lodge and Napo Wildlife Center. Includes a five-setting comparison table and a nine-question FAQ.
- [Nicaragua](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/nicaragua): Best proposal spots in Nicaragua
- [Panama](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/panama): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Panama, including the overwater villa sundecks of Bocas del Toro on the Caribbean side, the uninhabited outer sandbars of Cayos Holandeses in San Blas (Guna Yala) reached only by private catamaran, the Las Bovedas colonial sea wall in Casco Viejo facing the Pacific and the Panama City skyline, the private-island coves of Islas Secas in the Gulf of Chiriqui (one couple per island), and the Finca Lerida cloud forest overlook in the Boquete highlands. Covers the two-coast weather split (Pacific dry mid-December to mid-April, Bocas del Toro clearest in September to October and February to March), proposal photographer costs ($450 to $950 for 2 to 3 hours), staged moment totals ($1,200 to $3,350) and full stays ($2,100 to $16,500+), US-dollar currency and no-visa entry for US citizens, and getting to the islands via Tocumen and Albrook airports. Includes a five-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Colombia](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/colombia): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Colombia, including the coral-stone ramparts of the Baluarte de Santo Domingo in Cartagena's walled city, the upper ridgeline meadows of the Valle de Cocora and its 60-metre Quindio wax palms in the coffee region near Salento, the private timber sky decks of Bosko above the Guatape reservoir near Medellin, the viewing deck of Cayo Cangrejo off Providencia over the Sea of Seven Colors, the sandstone cliff ledge of Salto del Mico above the Suarez canyon in Barichara, the chartered private islets and sunset catamarans of the Rosario Islands off Cartagena, and the residential garden lawns of Hacienda Bambusa in the coffee region. Leads with Colombia's defining trait that climate runs by altitude rather than season (hot Caribbean coast at Cartagena, spring-like Medellin, mild coffee region, and cool high-altitude Bogota all at once), with two nationwide dry windows roughly December to March and July to August. Covers proposal photographer costs ($250 to $450 for a 1.5 to 2 hour city session, $550 to $950 for editorial and drone coverage), staged moment totals ($900 to $4,500) and full three-night stays ($2,000 to $8,500+), the favorable Colombian peso exchange for US-dollar travelers, 45 to 60 minute domestic flights on Avianca, LATAM, Clic and SATENA versus 9 to 11 hour overland drives, no-visa entry up to 90 days for US citizens plus the mandatory online Check-Mig form 72 to 24 hours before boarding, altitude acclimatization in Bogota and at Monserrate (3,150m), Pacific humpback whale watching off Nuqui from July to October, and luxury stays including Sofitel Legend Santa Clara, Casa San Agustin, Four Seasons Casa Medina, Hacienda Bambusa and Bosko. Includes a five-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Sri Lanka](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/sri-lanka): Best proposal and honeymoon spots in Sri Lanka, including the private lakeside lawns of Dunkeld Bungalow at Ceylon Tea Trails in the Hatton highlands (resident guests only), the 40-metre cliff-edge lawn at Cape Weligama above the Indian Ocean, the granite-screened crescent of Silent Beach near Tangalle, the summit of Pidurangala at dawn facing Sigiriya Lion Rock, the Dutch colonial ramparts and lighthouse of Galle Fort, Little Adam's Peak above the Ella Gap, and private sailing catamarans out of Mirissa. Covers the two-monsoon split that hits opposite coasts at opposite times (south, west and hill country best December to March; east coast around Trincomalee and Arugam Bay best May to September), proposal photographer costs ($150 to $400 local, $450 to $900 editorial), staged moment totals ($725 to $1,440) and full luxury stays ($3,170 to $8,950+), the private chauffeur-guide model for touring the island, whale watching off Mirissa (November to April) and Trincomalee (May to October), Yala leopard safaris, the Ella Odyssey scenic train, and ETA visa entry for US citizens via eta.gov.lk. Includes a five-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ.
- [Hawaii](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/hawaii): Best proposal spots in Hawaii
- [Paris](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/paris): Best proposal spots in Paris, including the Trocadero upper terrace, Pont de Bir-Hakeim mid-span, Pont Alexandre III, Square du Vert-Galant on Ile de la Cite, Sacre-Coeur stairs at dawn, and private Seine bateau experiences. Covers paris proposal spots, golden-hour windows (8:15pm in June, 7:45pm in September), Eiffel Tower light show schedule, photo permit requirements for the Tuileries, private bateau rental options, where to stay (7th, 4th, 1st arrondissements), and costs from $650 to $4,300+. Includes a seven-setting comparison table and eight-question FAQ.
- [United States](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/united-states): Best proposal spots across the United States
- [Patagonia](https://www.proposalspots.com/destinations/patagonia): Best proposal spots in Patagonia, spanning Chilean and Argentine Patagonia. Top settings include Mirador Base Las Torres at sunrise in Torres del Paine (Chile), Mirador Británico in the French Valley on the W trek, the Salto Grande / Lago Pehoé viewpoint (drive-up Cuernos backdrop), Laguna de los Tres at Fitz Roy from El Chaltén (Argentina), the Mirador de los Cóndores above El Chaltén (easy-access Fitz Roy panorama), the Perito Moreno glacier boardwalks at Los Glaciares National Park, and Cerro Campanario above Bariloche (year-round chairlift summit). Covers Patagonia proposal packages ($630 to $1,620 for the moment with photographer and park access; $1,050 to $4,950+ with lodge stays), photographer tips ($400 to $900 with local Puerto Natales / El Chaltén / El Calafate photographers strongly preferred), best times (late February to mid-March for Torres del Paine wind calm; November and early December for Fitz Roy clarity; 1pm to 4pm for Perito Moreno calving), CONAF park entry booking through pasesparques.cl (~$35 USD high season), wind extremes of 80-110 km/h on exposed ridges in December and January, helicopter charters from $4,000+, and the Chilean vs. Argentine side decision. Includes a six-setting comparison table and an eight-question FAQ covering where to propose, costs, timing, photographer hiring, Chile vs. Argentina, trip length, and package contents.

- [The Marry Me Proposal](https://www.proposalspots.com/blog/marry-me-proposal): Which marry me formats actually work, which ones backfire, what they cost, and how to do the big gesture without handing the moment to a crowd
- [Private Engagement Proposal Ideas](https://www.proposalspots.com/blog/private-engagement-proposal-ideas): Private engagement proposal ideas that feel intimate, not small. Where to go, how to plan around privacy, and when a quiet proposal is the right call
